title: risk_classification_claims_response
description: Categorical risk claims for a merge request, with evidence. No score or confidence value is part of this schema - those are computed by the Rails scoring function from these claims.

claims.description: Exactly one entry per domain in the risk_domains given to the agent.

name.description: The domain name, exactly as given in risk_domains, e.g. authorization.

value.description: Whether the change touches this domain. Either "true" or "false", as a string.

evidence.description: A path:line reference into the diff supporting this answer. Omit when the answer is "false" and no line supports a negative.

summary.description: Short plain-language explanation of what the change does and where its risk lies.
